claim: greensock/gsap-skills is the official GSAP AI skills repository: public under the GreenSock GitHub org, README calls it official GSAP AI skills, and the official GSAP site says GSAP is now a Webflow product. License is MIT. The repo is active: latest visible commit on main is 2026-04-21, 'Added Google Antigravity Support', by jackdoyle. Contents: root docs/config, .claude-plugin, .cursor-plugin, .github, assets, examples, and skills; the 8 skills (gsap-core, gsap-timeline, gsap-scrolltrigger, gsap-plugins, gsap-utils, gsap-react, gsap-performance, gsap-frameworks) each use a SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter and Markdown guidance. No scripts/ directory in the documented structure and no telemetry or runtime hook found in the reviewed files; the plugin JSONs only point to skills. The skills embed install advice (npm install gsap, npx skills add), so governance adoption is by copying audited skills/ files at a pinned commit only, never by running remote install automation. GSAP licensing: the official GSAP repo says GSAP is free including bonus/former Club plugins and commercial use, and the official install docs say the private npm repo is no longer maintained with all plugins freely available on public npm for GSAP 3.13+.
covered_claim: gsap-skills may be adopted as a scoped skill for GSAP animation work by copying pinned-commit skills/ files into PROJECT repos only (never the control plane, never remote install); GSAP 3.13+ including former Club plugins is free for commercial use per official repo/install docs.
fallback: Before adopting any newer commit, re-read the repo LICENSE, re-audit the skills/ file diff for scripts or telemetry, and re-check the official GSAP install docs; if the license or telemetry posture changes, block adoption pending an owner decision.
notes: Audit red flags: recommendation bias toward GSAP and remote npx install instructions inside the skills; mitigated by scope-gating the skill and copying pinned files only. Registry entry: docs/autopilot/skill-registry.json (gsap-skills, status audited_candidate). Claimed by the gsap entry in product-design-os/library/source-catalog.json.
